heroHeadline: EU Wildfire Total Tops 668,000 Hectares as EFFIS Warns of Very Extreme Fire Danger in France, Pyrenees
heroSubtitle: EFFIS put the EU's cumulative 2026 wildfire total at 668,035 hectares as of 16 September, up ~1,501 hectares over one day and still well below 2025's record pace but nearly double the 20-year average for this point in the season. The agency's fire danger forecast for 17-23 September flags very extreme conditions across most of France, the Pyrenees and northwestern Morocco. No new wildfire outbreaks, fatalities or evacuations have been confirmed across Spain, France, Italy, Portugal, Greece or Romania since early September, and Cernavodă's reactors remain offline as Danube flow stays insufficient to support a restart.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
